RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: unknown—not responsibly estimable from these facts

An all-male panel is worth raising as a question about process, but it is not proof that sex influenced the decision. Your stronger academic record warrants asking how qualifications were weighted; industry experience, interview performance and role requirements could legitimately matter.

Follow up now on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, your assessment against them, the reasons for the decision, and any policy on panel composition. Frame the concern neutrally: “Did the panel’s composition comply with university equality and recruitment policies?”

Check complaint deadlines promptly with your union or an equality adviser; don’t assume waiting for a reply pauses them. Legal rights depend on jurisdiction.
